units.source_text: 我下决心去死之后，已过去十多天了，

en.t: More than ten days have passed since I resolved to die,

units.source_text: 但是你要知道，这大部分时间是用于给你写这篇长长自传的一部分。

en.t: but you should know that most of that time has been spent writing this part of my long autobiography for you.

units.source_text: 起初我想同你见面再谈的，

en.t: At first I intended to meet you and speak about it in person,

units.source_text: 但动笔之后，反而觉得这样更能清晰地描绘出自己，感觉心情很愉快。

en.t: but once I began writing, I felt instead that this way let me portray myself more clearly, and it made me feel glad.

units.source_text: 我并非心血来潮随笔一写，

en.t: I am not writing this from a passing whim,

units.source_text: 我想把造就了我这个人的，只有我才能讲出来的经历，作为人类经验的一部分，毫无虚饰地记录下来。

en.t: I want to record plainly, without ornament, the experiences that made me who I am and that only I can tell, as one part of human experience.

units.source_text: 我的这番努力，对于认识人性，对于你，对于其他的人，都不会是徒劳吧。

en.t: Surely this effort of mine will not be wasted in understanding human nature, for you or for others.

units.source_text: 前几天，我刚刚听到一个关于渡边华山的故事，他为了画完《黄粱一炊图》此画可以说表现了华山临死前的心境。这幅画，将自杀时间推迟了一个星期。

en.t: A few days ago I heard a story about Watanabe Kazan: in order to finish The Dream of Handan, a painting that may be said to show Kazan's state of mind before death, he postponed his suicide by one week.

units.source_text: 在一般人看来，也许会说这是多余的，

en.t: To ordinary people, that might seem unnecessary,

units.source_text: 而对他本人来说，自有他对自己的要求，也可以说是不得已的吧。

en.t: but for the man himself, he had his own demand upon himself, and it might be called unavoidable.

units.source_text: 我所作出的这些努力，也不仅仅是为了履行对你的承诺，

en.t: These efforts of mine are not merely for the sake of fulfilling my promise to you,

units.source_text: 一多半还是对自身的要求导致的结果。

en.t: more than half of them are the result of being driven by a demand within myself.
